description: Structured evidence provenance, authoritative source documentation, and scoring rationales for Hemera built-in detector rules.

cloudflare.proxy.scoring_rationale: Server header (Server: cloudflare) or cf-ray header provides decisive proof of Cloudflare reverse proxy routing (75 points / high). Supporting headers (cf-cache-status), CNAME records, TLS certificates, and cf_clearance cookies provide supporting corroboration (20-35 points) and require multiple groups to detect.

cloudflare-server-header.rationale: Server: cloudflare header emitted on all Cloudflare-proxied HTTP responses.

cloudflare-ray-header.rationale: cf-ray header assigned uniquely to each HTTP request by Cloudflare edge nodes.

cloudflare-cache-header.rationale: cf-cache-status header indicates cache state on Cloudflare edge responses.

cloudflare-cname.rationale: Canonical Cloudflare CDN CNAME domain routing (cdn.cloudflare.net).

cloudflare-cert-issuer.rationale: TLS certificate issued by Cloudflare managed Certificate Authority.

cloudflare-clearance-cookie.rationale: cf_clearance cookie set upon passing interactive or JavaScript challenge.

cloudflare.challenge_page.scoring_rationale: cf-mitigated: challenge response header or challenge platform script (/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/) decisively identifies Cloudflare active challenge interstitials (75 points). cf-error-code header and challenge container DOM markers provide supporting corroboration.

cloudflare-challenge-mitigated-header.rationale: cf-mitigated: challenge response header emitted when Cloudflare serves an interactive challenge interstitial.

cloudflare-challenge-error-header.rationale: cf-error-code response header accompanying challenge and security mitigation pages.

cloudflare-challenge-block-marker.rationale: Cloudflare challenge wrapper and container DOM markers (cf-challenge, cf-wrapper).

cloudflare.bot_protection.scoring_rationale: Cloudflare Bot Management JavaScript telemetry script (/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/) decisively identifies client-side bot protection (75 points). __cf_bm cookie provides supporting session evidence (40 points) and cannot trigger detection alone.

cloudflare-bot-telemetry-script.rationale: Cloudflare JavaScript Detections (JSD) telemetry script under /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/ for Bot Management signal collection.

cloudflare-bot-cookie.rationale: __cf_bm cookie for Cloudflare Bot Management session tracking and rate calculations.

cloudflare.turnstile.scoring_rationale: Turnstile client API script (challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js) decisively identifies Cloudflare Turnstile integration (75 points). cf-turnstile HTML marker provides supporting structural evidence (30 points).

turnstile-html-marker.rationale: Explicit Turnstile container element with cf-turnstile class name.

google.recaptcha.scoring_rationale: Google reCAPTCHA client script (recaptcha/api.js or enterprise.js) decisively identifies reCAPTCHA integration (75 points). g-recaptcha container marker (30 points) and grecaptcha.render invocation (35 points) provide supporting evidence.

recaptcha-client-script.rationale: Official Google reCAPTCHA and reCAPTCHA Enterprise client loader scripts (recaptcha/api.js, enterprise.js).

aws.cloudfront.scoring_rationale: x-amz-cf-id, x-amz-cf-pop, or Server: CloudFront response header decisively identifies Amazon CloudFront edge routing (75 points). x-cache diagnostic header, cloudfront.net CNAME, and Amazon CA TLS certificate provide supporting corroboration (20-35 points).

aws-cf-id-header.rationale: x-amz-cf-id header containing unique CloudFront transaction request ID.

aws-cf-pop-header.rationale: x-amz-cf-pop header identifying CloudFront edge point of presence.

aws-cf-server-header.rationale: Server: CloudFront header emitted on Amazon CloudFront edge responses.

aws-cf-cache-header.rationale: x-cache header indicating CloudFront cache hit or miss status.

aws-cf-cert-issuer.rationale: TLS certificate issued by Amazon Certificate Authority.

aws.waf.scoring_rationale: AWS WAF JavaScript SDK (/aws-waf-sdk/), x-amzn-waf-action header, or AWS WAF challenge interstitial DOM decisively identifies AWS WAF (75 points). aws-waf-token cookie (40 points), x-amzn-errortype header (35 points), and aws-waf-container marker (30 points) provide supporting evidence.

aws-waf-sdk-script.rationale: Official AWS WAF JavaScript SDK integration script /aws-waf-sdk/.

aws-waf-action-header.rationale: x-amzn-waf-action header emitted on challenge and CAPTCHA mitigation responses.

aws-waf-errortype-header.rationale: x-amzn-errortype header containing WAF indicator; supporting diagnostic signal.

aws-waf-block-page.rationale: Standard AWS WAF CAPTCHA/challenge container title and DOM structure.

aws-waf-token-cookie.rationale: aws-waf-token cookie storing client verification token.

aws-waf-marker.rationale: AWS WAF integration element container aws-waf-container or AwsWafIntegration invocation.

datadome.bot_protection.scoring_rationale: DataDome client JS tag (js.datadome.co/tags.js or versioned vX.Y.Z/tags.js), x-datadome response header, or CAPTCHA delivery interstitial (*.captcha-delivery.com/captcha/) decisively identifies DataDome (75 points). datadome cookie (40 points) and datadomeOptions marker (35 points) provide supporting corroboration.

datadome-js-tag.rationale: Official DataDome client integration script js.datadome.co/tags.js or versioned tags.js path.

datadome-header.rationale: x-datadome response header emitted by DataDome server-side / reverse-proxy module.

datadome-response-header.rationale: x-datadome-response diagnostic header on protected routes.

datadome-interstitial-url.rationale: DataDome CAPTCHA and interstitial verification iframe URL (*.captcha-delivery.com/captcha/).

datadome-cookie.rationale: datadome cookie containing client behavioral tracking identifier.

datadome-marker.rationale: DataDome client configuration object datadomeOptions or datadome_client marker.

akamai.edge.scoring_rationale: Server: AkamaiGHost, x-akamai-transformed header, or Akamai canonical CNAME domain (edgekey.net, akamaiedge.net, edgesuite.net) decisively identifies Akamai Edge infrastructure routing (75 points). x-akamai-request-id (35 points), x-check-cacheable (25 points), X-Akamai-Session-Info (25 points), and Akamai TLS certificates (20 points) provide supporting evidence.

akamai-ghost-server-header.rationale: Server: AkamaiGHost header emitted on Akamai Global Host edge server responses.

akamai-transformed-header.rationale: x-akamai-transformed diagnostic header emitted by Akamai Edge servers.

akamai-cname.rationale: Canonical Akamai Edge CNAME domain (edgekey.net, akamaiedge.net, edgesuite.net).

akamai-request-id-header.rationale: x-akamai-request-id diagnostic header on edge responses.

akamai-cacheable-header.rationale: x-check-cacheable diagnostic header emitted by Akamai caching layer.

akamai-session-info-header.rationale: X-Akamai-Session-Info debugging header configured via Property Manager variables.

akamai-cert-issuer.rationale: TLS certificate issued by Akamai managed certificate authority.

akamai.bot_manager.scoring_rationale: Akamai Bot Manager sensor script (/akam/13/ or /akam/11/) decisively identifies client-side Bot Manager integration (75 points). bm_sz cookie (40 points), _abck cookie (40 points), and telemetry marker (35 points) provide supporting evidence.

akamai-bm-sensor-script.rationale: Akamai Bot Manager telemetry sensor script with /akam/13/ or /akam/11/ path structure.

akamai-bm-cookie.rationale: bm_sz or bm_sv cookie tracking client behavioral telemetry.

akamai-bm-abck-cookie.rationale: _abck cookie maintaining Akamai Bot Manager state and challenge resolution.

akamai-bm-marker.rationale: Akamai Bot Manager sensor initialization markers and configuration attributes.

hcaptcha.challenge.scoring_rationale: Official hCaptcha client script (js.hcaptcha.com/1/api.js or assets.hcaptcha.com/c/) or challenge iframe (newassets.hcaptcha.com/captcha/) decisively identifies hCaptcha integration (75 points). h-captcha container marker (30 points) and hcaptcha.render invocation (35 points) provide supporting evidence.

hcaptcha-client-script.rationale: Official hCaptcha client script js.hcaptcha.com/1/api.js or assets.hcaptcha.com/c/.

hcaptcha-challenge-iframe.rationale: Official hCaptcha interactive challenge iframe newassets.hcaptcha.com/captcha/.

arkoselabs.matchkey.scoring_rationale: Official Arkose Labs client script (client-api.arkoselabs.com/v2/api.js) or challenge iframe (client-api.arkoselabs.com/fc/) decisively identifies Arkose Labs Matchkey integration (75 points). arkose-enforcement marker (30 points) and setupArkoseEnforcement invocation (35 points) provide supporting evidence.

arkose-client-script.rationale: Official Arkose Labs client script client-api.arkoselabs.com/v2/api.js.

arkose-html-marker.rationale: Arkose Labs widget container class arkose-enforcement.
